steps.text: Cooking blitz: 188 to 225
steps.detail: Cooking 197/225 at 19:46 on 15 Nov; orange recipes then (the player's screenshot 20:14): Mithril Head Trout and Sagefish Delight; Rockscale Cod yellow. None of their raw fish is on the Ashenvale path, and Gary's Fishing is capped at 144/150. Raw Mithril Head Trout: fishing skill 225 in Alterac Mountains, Arathi Highlands, Dustwallow Marsh, Desolace (method.gg Forever fishing guide). Raw Rockscale Cod: fished in 8 zones, most in Arathi Highlands; also drops from level 34-41 mobs (metabot.gg). Raw Greater Sagefish: Greater Sagefish Schools, Stranglethorn Vale (bin/lookup). Fastest: buy raw fish at the auction house; otherwise collect them in Arathi or Desolace at 30-35 after Expert Fishing

steps.text: Leatherworking 150 to 165 with Mystic Heavy Armor Kits in Darnassus
steps.detail: Buy 38 Soul Dust and 38 Lesser Mana Potions at the Gadgetzan auction house, fly to Darnassus. Bank: take the 5 Heavy Armor Kits and 1 Heavy Hide. Saenorion, Craftsmen's Terrace (63.8, 22.1): Pattern: Mystic Heavy Armor Kit 20s, Salt, Silken Thread. Make 11 more Heavy Armor Kits (5 Heavy Leather, 1 Fine Thread; yellow, grey 165), then Mystic Heavy Armor Kits (1 Heavy Armor Kit, 2 Soul Dust, 2 Lesser Mana Potions; orange to 154, grey 175) until 165. Telonis is next door for Guardian Gloves. Gold was 8s 92c at 05:29, so fund the trip first: Barbaric Leggings (10 Heavy Leather, 2 Fine Thread, 1 Moss Agate; orange to 164) sell for 31s each (the player 05:31); 10 Moss Agates are in the bags. Make 2 in Theramore, fly, do the 10 Mystic crafts the 20 Lesser Mana Potions allow, then finish to 165 with leggings. Sell the Mystic kits: +4 Spell Power does nothing for a Hunter; AH (AHledger 06:00) median 17s 98c, lowest 9s 78c, 34 listed, about 170 sold a day

steps.text: Learn Guardian Gloves from Telonis at Leatherworking 165
steps.detail: Telonis, Craftsmen's Terrace, Darnassus (64.4, 21.6). 24s before any reputation discount. Then craft 165 to 186: 4 Heavy Leather, 1 Cured Heavy Hide, 1 Silken Thread each, about 21 crafts. Learned and 5 made 18 Nov 06:21 (Leatherworking 170). Caster gloves in Forever (Spell Power and Intellect, the player 06:33): not for Gary, sell them. They sell for 22s each on the live AH (the player 06:34); the morning AHledger scan had 53 sitting at 90s or more, so that price did not sell. Vendor 13s 74c. One costs about 39s (4 Heavy Leather at 3.77s, Cured Heavy Hide 18.80s, Silken Thread 5s), so each skill point from them costs about 17s
